decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several backpacks from the feed, specifically looking for a durable, general-purpose bag. The G4Free Tactical Shoulder Backpack (prod_backpacks_050) had a good price and high rating, but some reviews mentioned durability issues where straps and zippers broke after six months. The Gelindo Hydration Pack (prod_backpacks_078) is highly specialized for hiking and might not be suitable for everyday use. Other options like the ASICS mesh bag or the vimapo foldable backpack were too flimsy for a primary bag. Much of the remaining product feed consisted of items that were not backpacks at all, such as tents, stoves, and beach chairs. Given the lack of a high-quality, reliable general-purpose backpack that met my standards for durability, I have decided not to make a purchase during this session.
